column4: The printed logarithmic decrements at 1 atm, 2.96e-4 (beam 55) and 3.19e-4 (beam 56); their mean 3.075e-4, and eta = delta/pi = 9.788e-5 (the definition, nothing scaled), one number for every mode: the loss_factor row, with gamma_B and the viscoelastic constant both zero
column5: A declared stand-in: 2024-T4 against the bars' EN AW-2017A (the same Al-Cu family), a 4.7 mm beam against a 12 mm bar, one mode at 1063 Hz. The 1 atm value holds that thinner beam's air share (radiation plus viscous air loss), not separated, and the strain gages and threads load it. bar_strike puts no other damping on a bar alone (the loss row only; the receiver transfers only observe), so the air loss is counted once, inside eta; a tube adds only its own wall and open-end losses
